Tier i82 Life Flasks._note: OFF BY DEFAULT. hide_at_strictness 0 means 'hide from soft upward', i.e. at every level — that is how a tier ships disabled but stays user-enablable: clear the gate in the Strictness Gates editor and it shows. ilvl 82 is not the base's drop level (Divine 60 / Eternal 65) but the MOD ceiling: Chemist's (FlaskChargesUsed5) and Ample (FlaskExtraCharges5), the two prefixes worth keeping a flask for, both require level 82 in Mods.json. Same breakpoint Utility Flasks already uses.

Tier Hybrid Flasks._note: Hybrid Flasks had no home anywhere in the tree, so all six drew a full label in maps off the final show-all layer. Author's call: useless, hide by default, user can turn it on. So this is a GATED hide (hide_at_strictness 0) and NOT is_hide_tier — the 🔒 protect toggle clears a gate but cannot undo is_hide_tier, so only the gated form is one click away from showing. They live in this file because Life.json's _meta already carries all six Hybrid translations.

Tier Hide Life Flasks._note: The Minimal net. Without a class_condition this tier only caught bases explicitly mapped to it (one: Small Life Flask), so every other life flask fell through the whole tree to the final show-all layer and drew a full label in maps. AreaLevel >= 68 keeps the campaign untouched — the _campaign module owns everything below 68 and emits first.
